programme.title: Relative Justice with Judge Rhonda Wills
programme.desc: : Foster siblings face off in court as Noah Berumen sues his foster sister, Loren Terris, for $4,255 in unpaid loans. The episode examines trust, family dynamics, and the challenges of enforcing financial agreements within close-knit relationships.

programme.title: Relative Justice with Judge Rhonda Wills
programme.desc: After a breakup, Rebecca Lien takes legal action against her ex-boyfriend for unpaid rent and property damage, highlighting the tension that can arise when personal relationships and financial responsibilities collide.

programme.title: Relative Justice with Judge Rhonda Wills
programme.desc: In this case, plaintiff Kimberly Erb is taking legal action against her ex-boyfriend, Mike Trent, seeking $5,000 for an unpaid car loan. Kimberly asserts that Mike agreed to contribute toward or repay the loan, while Mike maintains that he never consented to take responsibility for it. The dispute highlights the complexities of financial obligations between former partners and the challenges that arise when agreements are disputed after a relationship ends. The episode delves into issues of accountability, contractual understanding, and the intersection of personal relationships with financial commitments.

programme.title: Relative Justice with Judge Rhonda Wills
programme.desc: n this heated family courtroom clash, Pearl Jones takes the stand against her own cousin, Taj Lassiter, suing him for $3,297 in car damage. Pearl insists Taj’s reckless actions led to the costly repairs — but Taj fires back, claiming Pearl provoked the whole incident and owes him nothing. What starts as a battle over car damage quickly turns into a fiery showdown of pride, blame, and family loyalty. Will justice—or family drama—win the day?

programme.title: Death Valley & Mono Lake
programme.desc: Experience the dramatic beauty of Death Valley, from sunrise over the sand dunes to the colorful formations of Zabriske point. Explore the unique limestone formations known as "tufa towers", the amazing bird life, and relaxing serenity of Mono Lake, an inland sea at the base of the Sierra Mountains. Bonus footage of the geothermal "hot creek" in the Sierras. This film is newly extended with awe-inspiring footage of the nesting Ospreys and aerial views of Mono Lake!

programme.title: Morning at the Marsh

programme.title: California's Wild Coast

This 2.5 hour film is an exhilarating flight over this magnificent landscape. Soul stirring ambient music accompanies the spectacular cinematography of "California's Wild Coast"

programme.title: Journey Through Alaska Preview

programme.title: FishON | Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!
